access: read and write the touch ledger; refuses sends that break the rules
connectsTo: A local SQLite file on the employee's machine. No network access.
permissions: Read and write one local SQLite file owned by the employee's unix user; no other file or network access
riskNote: Low in what it can touch, but it is the safety net: it is where the limits are enforced in code, so a bug here removes the protection the other entries rely on. It must refuse a send when there are already two touches for that quote or invoice, outside Monday to Friday 08:00 to 18:00 in the owner's time zone, to a customer marked do-not-contact-automatically, or for an invoice over the owner's limit (that becomes a draft). The employee may write to the ledger only through this script. The script does not exist yet, so there is no version to pin; writing it is part of building an employee after purchase, not this ticket. Needs tests for each refusal rule when it is written.
